description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application developed in Kotlin. It manages a navigation drawer combined with a bottom navigation view to switch between three main fragments: Home, Dashboard, and Settings. The class handles fragment creation, state restoration, synchronization of navigation UI components, user interactions, and back press behavior.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity managing navigation drawer, bottom navigation, and fragment switching among Home, Dashboard, and Settings screens.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up toolbar, drawer, bottom navigation, fragments, and back button handling.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the currently selected destination ID for configuration changes.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation 'up' action, opening the navigation drawer.

methods.name: setupNavigationListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for bottom navigation and drawer navigation.

methods.name: ensureFragmentsCreated
methods.description: Creates all necessary fragments if they do not exist, often used during initial setup or restoration.

methods.name: selectDestination
methods.description: Handles showing the selected fragment and updating UI components based on the destination.

methods.name: normalizeDestinationId
methods.description: Maps menu item IDs to standardized destination IDs.

methods.name: syncNavigationSelection
methods.description: Synchronizes the UI navigation components (bottom nav and drawer) with the current selection.
